title: how to change the timezone for a dashboard logged in user
text:
Say goodbye to data discrepancies and hello to personalized data viewing with the Timezone Switcher for Dashboard!
TABLE OF CONTENTS
 [#Important-Notes] Important Notes
 [#How-to-Change-the-Timezone] How to Change the Timezone
 [#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Open-Your-Dashboard] Step 1: Open Your Dashboard

 [#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Choose-Your-Timezone] Step 3: Choose Your Timezone
Important Notes

The selected timezone will be applied to all the dashboards you view.

Timezone changes only affect internal data metrics, not third-party dependent widgets

To learn more about the Custom Dashboards,  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001530] click here!
How to Change the DashboardTimezone

Follow the steps below to change the timezone shown on the dashboard for the logged in user!

Step 1: Open Your Dashboard

Whether it's your private dashboard or a shared one, navigate to the dashboard you want to customize by selecting Dashboard on the left-side navigation bar.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061627072/original/0rr6MBwvKjxpqsvZ5naROHsGBSlBqcqj0Q.png?1767115891] 

Step 2: Access Timezone Settings

Click on the 3-dot menu icon located on the top right corner and select Manage Dashboard Timezone from the dropdown

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061627188/original/f3RDaBSAtTAd_vqHbGR7j2uu2yYU-SWiAw.png?1767115984] 

Step 3: Choose Your Timezone

From the dropdown menu, select your preferred timezone then save your changes.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061627277/original/3NueyrIVMlAxD0OAbN6IWncXc9rRtofXUQ.png?1767116057]
